title: Three F08 machines decoded: a zone beside a mirror, an odometer with regular low digits, a window between an archive and a stream
text: 1RB0LC_1LC0RE_1RA1LD_1LA1LC_1RF0RA_---0LA: all but a few hundred cells at the left end are one ten-cell word; Lean proves a round trip through that body gives the zone the same cells back for every length (trip), so a zone model with the body kept short follows the real machine exactly and finds no halt in 8.8·1015 steps. 1RB0RA_1LC0RC_1LF0RD_1RA1LE_0LC---_1LD0LA: the separators count like odometer digits, exactly periodic in the three lowest levels (8, 16, 64 sweeps) and irregular above; four sweeps proved in Lean; no halt in 3.1·1016 steps. 1RB1LD_1RC0RC_1LD0RE_0LB0LA_0RF1LA_---1RC: each round trip rewrites only a window of about 30 cells at its turning point, between an untouched archive and a stream carried two cells to the right.
